ttl.name: Front Side Fixed Window Assembly LH

s-1.ptxt: Clean Front Side Fixed Window Assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Using a scraper or equivalent, scrape off any adhesive remaining on the front side fixed window assembly LH. (When reusing front side fixed window assembly LH)

atten3.ptxt: Do not damage the front side fixed window assembly LH.

s2.ptxt: Clean the outer circumference of the front side fixed window assembly LH with white gasoline.

atten3.ptxt: Be sure to clean a new front side fixed window assembly LH as well.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Side Fixed Window Assembly LH

s3.ptxt: If the adhesive remaining on the vehicle has significant unevenness, smooth it using a utility knife.

atten3.ptxt: Be sure to leave a small amount of adhesive.

s3.ptxt: Clean the body installation surface with white gasoline.

s2.ptxt: Work before Installing Front Side Fixed Window Assembly LH

s3.ptxt: Attach suction cups to the front side fixed window assembly LH.
Using the specified primer, apply it to the areas where the body surface of the vehicle is exposed (where no adhesive remains).

item.ptxt: Do not apply it to the adhesive.
Take particular care when applying it to panel seams and spot weld positions.

s3.ptxt: Using the specified primer, apply primer to the front side fixed window assembly LH at the positions shown in the illustration.
Cut off the tip of the adhesive nozzle as shown in the illustration below.
Load the adhesive into a sealant gun.
Apply adhesive in a bead to the bonding area of the front side fixed window assembly LH as shown in the illustration below.

atten3.ptxt: Apply the adhesive after the primer has dried (approximately 3 minutes).

s2.ptxt: Install Front Side Fixed Window Assembly LH

s3.ptxt: Holding the suction cups, install the front side fixed window assembly LH.

item.ptxt: Install the front side fixed window assembly LH after the primer on the body side has dried (approximately 3 minutes).
Check from inside the vehicle that the front side fixed window assembly LH is engaged.

s3.ptxt: Lightly press the front surface of the front side fixed window assembly LH to ensure that it is fully sealed.
Using a spatula, correct any excess or insufficient adhesive.
Remove any excess adhesive before it hardens.
Using protective tape or equivalent, hold the front side fixed window assembly LH in place until the adhesive hardens.

atten4.ptxt: For the minimum drying time after bonding and the time until the vehicle can be driven, follow the instructions or instruction manual of each adhesive manufacturer.

s-1.ptxt: Inspect for Water Leaks and Repair

s2.ptxt: After the adhesive has hardened, pour water over the vehicle from the outside and check that there is no water leaking into the cabin.
If there is a water leak, allow it to dry and then fill with Three Cement Black.
Remove the protective tape and packing tape that were applied.
Install a new front pillar garnish clip to the garnish.
Insert the guide at the front end.
Engage the front pillar garnish clip and clip, and install the front pillar garnish LH.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Pillar Garnish Corner Piece LH

atten4.ptxt: Install using the same procedure as for the RH side.
